card.name: Word after 'to' in purpose phrases
card.fires_on: The word right after 'to' (or 'go') that opens a purpose or matching phrase, such as 'to go with', 'to suit', 'to coincide', 'to last', 'to serve as'. It expects a following 'with', 'as' or 'all'.
